models.name: Meta MMS — mms-tts-fas
models.notes: Zero-friction setup, no espeak needed. Reads digits one-by-one. Non-commercial license.

models.name: Kamtera — persian-tts-female-vits
models.notes: Coqui-format VITS. Needs espeak-ng phonemizer; runs in an isolated venv. 24 kHz.

models.name: Kamtera — persian-tts-male-vits
models.notes: Coqui-format VITS, male counterpart to the female model. 22.05 kHz.

models.name: karim23657 — GPTInformal-Persian VITS
models.notes: Trained on informal/colloquial Persian (GPTInformal dataset) — a more conversational tone. 24 kHz.

models.name: SeyedAli — Persian-Speech-synthesis-MMS
models.notes: MMS-style VITS finetune loaded via transformers (no espeak). Same code path as mms-tts-fas. 16 kHz.

models.name: Thomcles — Chatterbox-TTS-Persian-Farsi
models.voice: voice-cloned from a Persian reference clip
models.notes: Heavy autoregressive model (~0.5B). GATED repo (needs HF token). ~20s/sentence on CPU. Voice cloning — conditioned on a Persian reference clip. Non-commercial.

models.name: MahtaFetrat — Mana-Persian-Piper
models.notes: Piper voice trained on the curated ManaTTS corpus. Clean pronunciation, deterministic, ~0.2s/sentence on CPU. Ready-made ONNX — trivial to run. MIT.

models.name: IMS-Toucan — ToucanTTS (pes)
models.voice: zero-shot cloned from a Persian reference clip
models.notes: SOTA multilingual model (7000+ langs), Persian id 'pes'. Flow-matching decoder + zero-shot voice cloning. Runs on CPU (~5-8s/sentence). Research-grade quality.

models.name: Fish Audio — s2-pro (CPU probe)
models.engine: fish-speech Dual-AR LLM (4B) — native PyTorch on CPU
models.voice: cloned from a Persian reference clip
models.notes: SOTA / ElevenLabs-tier, 44.1 kHz — highest fidelity here. GPU model (SGLang) forced onto CPU via swap: ~34 min/sentence, so only sentence 01 was generated as a quality probe. Non-commercial research license.

models.name: Lumos675 — F5-TTS Persian
models.voice: cloned from a Persian reference clip
models.notes: F5-TTS flow-matching finetune — ships its own char vocab (complete). Zero-shot cloning, Apache-2.0. ~90s/sentence on CPU. A leading open naturalness candidate for Persian.

models.name: F5-TTS Persian — tuned
models.voice: cloned from a Persian reference clip
models.notes: Same model as f5-persian, TUNED: numbers/dates normalized to Persian words (phone numbers digit-by-digit), nfe_step 32->48. Fixes the digit/date mispronunciations and steadies output.

models.name: F5-TTS Persian — tuned + Ezafe + harakat
models.engine: F5-TTS v1 + text normalization + abreza/persian-ezafe-albert + KaamelDict G2P
models.voice: cloned from a Persian reference clip
models.notes: Same as f5-persian-tuned but with two more front-end stages: abreza/persian-ezafe-albert (F1 98.7%) inserts kasra ِ on Ezafe-bearing words, then KaamelDict (116k-word G2P) adds word-internal fatha/kasra/damma/sukun. Homograph overrides pick the number reading for digit-derived words (صِفْر not صَفَر, نُه not نَه).
